notes.title: Update 1.10 is Now Live!
notes.content:
Based on your super helpful feedback, we've made some improvements to the game including:

-Fixing the achievement issue with The Den
-Fixed a bug in a puzzle in The River

Thank you for playing Returner 77. If you liked the game consider leaving us a review. If you didn't like it also leave a review so we know how to improve! ːsteamhappyː
